c.id, c.campus_name, c.principal_user_id,

mapper.insert: insert into edu_campus (campus_name, principal_user_id, address, contact_phone, remark, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{campusName}, #{principalUserId}, #{address}, #{contactPhone}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update edu_campus set campus_name = #{campusName}, principal_user_id = #{principalUserId}, address = #{address}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from edu_campus c left join sys_user u on u.id = c.principal_user_id where c.id = #{id}
